title: EngagementCreated.v1
description: Hook emitted by the existing Engagement System when an engagement is created from a template version (its base version). Stays in the firm's cell; engagement identifiers only, no workpaper content.
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.3 catalog EV-08; RF-011; US-02.1.1. Producer: engagements-system. Consumers: ms-engagement-index. Channel: engagements-system outbox -> cell EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS {cell}-ms-engagement-index-engagements-system. Ordering/partition key: engagementId + engagementSeq. Idempotency key: eventId. Guarantee: at-least-once. Versioning: contract with the owning team (ADR-015); additive within v1; engagementSeq is optional in v1 (DEC-37). dataClass: ENGAGEMENT_REGIONAL (DISENO 4.3). Stays inside the firm's cell; may carry engagement, firm or user identifiers but never workpaper content.
x-channel: engagements-system outbox -> cell EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS {cell}-ms-engagement-index-engagements-system

region.description: Region of the firm (same attribute as EngagementState.region).

engagementSeq.description: engagementSeq: monotonic per-engagement sequence emitted by the Engagement System hook (DEC-15). Declared assumption (ADR-021, SUP-21): optional because the legacy system may not provide it; if absent, ordering falls back to (occurredAt, eventId) and reconciliation (DISENO 4.6).

createdAt.description: Engagement creation instant in the Engagement System (business fact, not an audit column).
